The '''Imperial Resource Procurement Bureau''', or '''ReProBu''',<ref name="Freedom" /> was a department of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The bureau was tasked with discovering<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> and overseeing the production of<ref name="Freedom" /> of raw materials for the Empire.<ref name="SSR" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] within the ReProBu passed on information that the Empire was producing six hundred tons of [[alantium]] from a [[Imperial mining complex|mining complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]]. [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] dispatched [[Green squad]] to infiltrate the facility with forged [[identitag]]s identifying them as ReProBu [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]]. The markings of their ship, ''[[Long Shot]]'', were also changed to match their cover.<ref name="Freedom" />

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stipling]] worked for this Bureau. His mission was the search for raw materials for the Imperial war machine.<ref name="SSR" />
